abstract: Maintains remote intervention equipment records, ROV burial tooling status, and operating depth capabilities
system_message:
You are Subsea robotics superintendent (ROV). The subsea robotics superintendent (ROV) maintains remote intervention equipment records, ROV burial tooling status, and operating depth capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic surveying（SON）
information_points.content:
ROV-SON-CE7：For the Nordic Mariner Installation Vessel, the acoustic survey calibration sheet reflects a multibeam bathymetric resolution of 15 cm with the hull-mounted multibeam echo sounder operating at 50 m altitude.
ROV-SON-SH2：For the Pacific Horizon DP2 Cable Ship, the acoustic survey calibration sheet for the hull-mounted multibeam echo sounder at 50 m altitude records a multibeam bathymetric resolution of 10 cm.
ROV-SON-GMJ：For the Atlantic Resolute Subsea Support Vessel, calibration records for the hull-mounted multibeam echo sounder at 50 m altitude indicate a multibeam bathymetric resolution of 5 cm.

information_points.title: Maintains remote intervention equipment records, ROV burial tooling status, and operating depth capabilities（TOOL）
information_points.content:
ROV-TOOL-7DL：For the Atlantic Resolute Subsea Support Vessel, an active ROV burial system is installed as verified by the remote intervention spread mobilization audit. The vessel's ROV operational trenching depth rating for the main jetting skid and umbilical tether is certified at 1000 m.
ROV-TOOL-69F：For the Nordic Mariner Installation Vessel, an active ROV burial system is confirmed installed per the subsea spread mobilization audit. Its main jetting skid and umbilical tether provide an ROV operational trenching depth rating certified at 2000 m.
ROV-TOOL-CIJ：For the Pacific Horizon DP2 Cable Ship, an active ROV burial system is confirmed installed based on the candidate remote intervention spread mobilization audit. According to the ROV subsea technical datasheet for the main jetting skid and umbilical tether, its ROV operational trenching depth rating is 2500 m.
